title: Amazon blocks Meta’s Muse AI agent
slides: Amazon just blocked Meta's Muse AI agent. Why?
Amazon cited security and competition concerns.
Yet Amazon's own AI tools continue to expand.
This means third-party AI could face more barriers.
If giants control AI access, who really loses?
thread_text:
Amazon Just Blocked Meta

Meta's new Muse AI agent was cut off from Amazon's platform. The reason? Amazon cited security and competition concerns.

Amazon's Real Concern

Security was the stated reason, but competition likely played a role. Meta's AI could threaten Amazon's own AI ambitions.

Amazon's AI Keeps Growing

While blocking Meta, Amazon expanded its own AI tools. This double standard shows how gatekeepers protect their turf.

Third-Party AI Barriers

If Amazon blocks Meta, other AI developers could face similar obstacles. This trend could stifle innovation and limit choice.

Who Really Loses?

When giants control AI access, users lose. Ask yourself: if Amazon blocks Meta's AI, will your favorite tool be next?
